PROP-01b-partial3-post-001.text: After repayBorrowBehalf, funds must be deducted from payer (msg.sender), not borrower.
PROP-01b-partial3-post-001.assertion: forall repayBehalf(payer, borrower, amt): payer.balance decreases AND borrower.borrowBalance decreases
